answer: Sample 5 percent of submissions each epoch, weight each audited claim by how many independent links separate auditor from author, and flag any payload seen before. The benefit is that a copied answer dies on replay even under a fresh name. The cost lands on the attacker: 1,000 aliases need 1,000 distinct answers plus auditors far enough away on the trust graph, and one duplicate resets the whole forge. A raven that reuses a line loses the kernel of its standing.
